bounded_work.guide_position: Bound count, item size, depth, cumulative bytes, jobs, queue, attempts separately; retries require idempotence, shared deadline

assertions_contracts.guide_position: assert cond; value for internal invariants (fires only when evaluated); force values needed to establish a contract; module assertions are a different mechanism

security.guide_position: Never put secrets in store paths/derivations/logs; treat substituters/keys/fetchers as trust boundaries; never disable sandbox; evaluate/build untrusted expressions under OS policy
security.best_practice: Oct 2026 coordinated disclosure shows evaluation of untrusted expressions itself, daemon repair operations, and macOS Seatbelt generation were privilege-escalation vectors, fixed only in the listed patch versions - the guide's 'build sandboxing is not a complete sandbox for arbitrary evaluation' is directionally right but does not name daemon/repair or the patch floor
security.evidence: Advisory fetched in full from NixOS Discourse (official), Oct 13 2026

proposals.proposal: Add an explicit minimum-patch floor and daemon threat note: require Nix >=2.34.9 on the 2.34 line or >=2.35.3 on the 2.35 line (or listed equivalents), state that unprivileged daemon repair and untrusted-expression evaluation are privilege boundaries, and drop unsupported 2.29/2.32/2.33 lines from any support claim
proposals.evidence: Oct 2026 advisory: list-allocation overflow on untrusted evaluation, unprivileged repair store-path replacement, Seatbelt escape; fixed versions enumerated
proposals.recommendation: Adopt immediately as a Sec.18/25 note; this is a security floor, not a style preference
